mountingHoles.comment: Six M10 base mounting-hole centers on the 210 mm pitch circle. The bolt count is specified by the FAIRINO FR20/FR30 installation drawing; centers were fitted from the six complete 10.5 mm diameter cylindrical rings in the official RoboDK FR20 base CAD. Generated by scripts/convert_robodk_library_package.py.

flangeMountingHoles.comment: Four M6 tool-flange mounting centers on a 63 mm pitch circle. The FAIRINO FR20/FR30 manual specifies four M6 threaded flange holes (8 mm maximum thread depth); the 63 mm pitch circle was measured from the official FR20 flange CAD. Generated by scripts/convert_robodk_library_package.py.

notes: Geometry is exported link-by-link from the official RoboDK FAIRINO FR20 library model.
Modified-DH dimensions were recovered exactly from RoboDK JointPoses at zero joints and verified against the 1854 mm nominal reach.
Joint limits and maximum velocities are the values reported by RoboDK and FAIRINO for FR20.
Acceleration and jerk limits are documented simulator assumptions of 4x and 16x the maximum joint velocity per second.
